draft.text: You came in because your lawyer told you to get medical attention and you need an MRI.
You were in a recent car crash and have neck pain that feels like a 12 out of 10.
You also have numbness in your left arm and right leg, which is getting worse.
We did not do any tests or exams during this visit.
You have a history of neck pain and numbness, which has gotten worse since your recent crash.
You had neck surgery before, but you don't remember the details.
You will be referred for an MRI to check your neck injury.
You will need to come back for a follow-up after the MRI results are ready.
